svg.title: R005 solution curves
svg.desc: Cutoff below threshold; reverse body bias shifts curves right with shrinking shifts. VDS = 3 V: saturation when on. VDS = 0.5 V: vertical guides mark triode boundaries.

g.text: R005: body effect and operating regions
Square law, no CLM; normalized current in V², normalized gm in V
Cutoff below threshold; reverse body bias shifts curves right with shrinking shifts.
VDS = 3 V: saturation when on. VDS = 0.5 V: vertical guides mark triode boundaries.
